primary_metric: Per-terrain per-M common pooled-normalization HV, reference 1.1. Do not compare absolute normalized HV between terrain cases.
scope: 90 prespecified screening runs, 180000 requests. Synthetic terrain and geometric wake extension, not measured-site or CFD validation. Three seeds are insufficient for confirmatory significance.
resource_rule: Two terrain optimizer workers in addition to the existing six V4 confirmation workers; BLAS threads fixed to one.
comparability: Within each case and seed all methods share the initial 100 layouts. Across terrains the slope-filtered candidate sets can differ. Lower effective area across terrain masks is not by itself evidence of a more compact layout; report gross envelope too.
